ownership: Four independently tagged uncached reads assemble complete private snapshots; canonical headers/padding and bounds gate child offers
All enabled vertex attributes must fit runtime capacity; fixed16-slot wire layouts are unchanged
Writable bin/page/directory/fragment staging and vertex prefixes cannot alias job/frame/draw descriptor storage
Cancellation retains offered memory/begin/draw/end controls and live tags; child and full frame result ownership drain before completion
Nested vertex address and complete child frame/tile attribution are retained; a child frame without an aggregate address reports zero address and retains its structured fault metadata

development_issue.cause: Simulator DPI generated overlong nested completion identifiers; C++ bridge compilation failed before RTL execution
development_issue.resolution: Test-only short completion port aliases preserve the complete production fields and assertions; no production interface or test data was removed

limitations: Combined renderer composition, real shared CUs/payload, translated virtual/physical namespaces and native host/MMIO/reset are not connected yet
Image descriptors are trusted physical metadata; allocator provenance and cross-domain physical alias checks remain enclosing responsibilities
This reader does not independently validate every child image/bin rule; the combined child must complete its whole-grid admission before accessing resources
No synthesis PPA or full Mobile rate/budget/product closure; all H0-H8 remain open
